To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) for selective broadcast, the optimal transmit signature is the same as the optimal transmit signature for the non-selective case; (2) for the selective broadcast case, the space-only design is optimal; (3) the space-only design can be solved by a simple diagonalization algorithm; (4) the STC-LPs are optimal for the space-time designs; (5) the space-time design is optimal when the number of users is larger than the number of transmit antennas; and
we propose three algorithms to solve the optimal transmit design problem for selective wireless broadcast.
we have proposed a new design for the selective broadcast scheme and we have shown that the existing ILDP algorithm can be extended to solve the space-time design.
In summary, our research is concerned with
optimal space-time transceiver designs for selective broadcast with channel state feedback.
the design of optimal space-time transceivers for selective broadcast schemes.
the optimal space-time transmit signature code for selective broadcast.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the ILDP algorithm can be used for the time-only design, the time-only design with space-time block codes and the space-only design.
the space-only design is the optimal design for the selective broadcast problem.
the STC-ILDP algorithm is optimal, but the STC-LPs are near-optimal and computationally much less expensive.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the STC-ILDP algorithm is the optimal design, the STC-LPD algorithm is suboptimal, and the iterative spatial diagonalization is a heuristic algorithm that performs well in practice.
the space-time design is optimal in the sense of minimizing total transmit power.
we provide a unified framework for solving the optimal space-time transmit signature code design problem for the selective broadcast scenario.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, for the space-only and the space-time designs, the STC-LPs are very effective, while for the time-only and the space-only designs, the ILDP algorithms are very effective.
the ILDP and STC-LP algorithms provide a general approach for solving a class of optimal space-time transceiver designs for selective broadcast.
the space-only design is optimal for selective broadcast with channel state and SNR information.
